decisions.rationale: No NOA or T4 is on file for a salaried applicant, and the employment letter base salary of $112,043.67 is about 10% below the stated $124,000 (INC-03).
The $14,200 deposit is supported only by a gift letter from a friend, which is not close family, and without it the remaining seasoned funds barely cover the $26,000 down payment plus closing costs.
The appraiser (Rive-Nord Evaluations) is on the panel and the report is recent, but the $512,000 value is below the $520,000 purchase price.
A recent (2026-09-29) signed letter on company letterhead confirms permanent full-time employment since 2020 with the stated employer.
GDS is about 30.6% and TDS about 37.9% (about 33.9% and 41.9% even on the letter salary), liabilities match the bureau, and credit score 706 meets DTI-02.
